g.text: Selective raster buffers: transient allocation peaks
32 environments, 512 x 512 pixels. The depth and RGB fast paths preserve public pixels, dtypes and ownership.
Tracemalloc peak of a call; prebuilt inputs/cache excluded. These are allocation observations, not process RSS.
Timing claims withheld: noisy initial controls and concurrent historical probes. Raw signed timings retained. No GPU/training claim.
